info.title: Bociarz LP API
info.description: REST API for Bociarz LP (derived from CLMM Liquidity Provider). Provides endpoints for position management, strategy automation, pool analysis, and portfolio analytics.

post.summary: Run a simulation.
Request a Phantom signMessage challenge.
Verify Phantom signature and return a session token (JWT).
Compute snapshot data readiness for backtests (coverage/max-gap/max-back-hours).
Spawn a historical backtest for a closed position (best-effort) using CLI `clmm-lp-cli backtest`.
Spawn a historical backtest for an open position using current open config.
Run FULL backtest matrix (curated pools × windows) via `backtest-optimize`.

get.summary: Get FULL backtest matrix job details/results.
Read tail of the IL / rebalance JSONL file when **`CLMM_IL_LEDGER_PATH`** is set (same path as `orca-bot-run --il-ledger-path`).
get.description: Rows use `event: "rebalance"` (and related IL schema); filter matches substring on JSON text (e.g. position or old position pubkey).

get.summary: Read tail of the lifecycle JSONL used for dashboard summaries.

post.summary: Post a short plain-text digest of recent lifecycle ledger rows to Slack (`SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`).

200.description: Detected rebalance sessions with close and missing open
Auto-enqueue eligible stranded sessions into pending-open recovery
Session dismissed and removed from pending-open automation

get.summary: Read persisted agent decisions from local JSONL store.

post.summary: Append one agent decision row to local JSONL store.

get.summary: Read normalized snapshot rows from local JSONL store.
Read normalized swap rows from local JSONL store.
Returns `slot0()` for a Slipstream pool on Base (requires `BASE_RPC_URL`).

502.description: Base RPC error or bad return data

get.description: Returns the current health status of the service.
Simple endpoint that returns 200 if the service is running.
Returns 200 if the service is ready to accept requests.

get.summary: List Whirlpool LP positions for an owner on-chain (RPC). Does not use `PositionMonitor`.
Rough **network fee** estimate for an in-pool Orca swap (from local lifecycle JSONL + default).

post.summary: Suggest `token_max_a/b` so an **in-range** open targets ~`target_usd` (fixes naive 50/50 USD caps).

400.description: Invalid input or price out of range

post.summary: Open a new position.
Start closing all monitored positions (async batch job).
Preview wallet groups and skipped positions before bulk close (no on-chain txs).

get.summary: List closed positions from the append-only registry (`registry.jsonl`).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many newest closed positions to skip (pagination)

parameters.name: enrich_pools
parameters.description: Fetch pool mints for pair labels (default true); false = registry only, no RPC

post.summary: Batch extras for Positions list rows (linked strategies + agent session).
Close stale `registry_open` rows (on-chain 404) and prune dead links from all strategies.
Executes an Orca Whirlpool swap (ExactIn) inside the same pool (SWAP-only step).

400.description: Invalid address or not a position account

404.description: Position account absent on-chain for this RPC cluster

200.description: UI payload for position agent tab

get.summary: Read materialized chain history from Postgres (fast path). Returns 404 until refresh.

200.description: Materialized lineage payload (same shape as stream-lineage)

404.description: No materialized rows for this anchor/mode

post.summary: Materialize Postgres read-model for chain history (parallel path to live `stream-lineage`).

401.description: When CLMM_CHAIN_HISTORY_REFRESH_SECRET is set: missing or wrong Bearer / X-Chain-History-Refresh

post.summary: Collect fees from a position.
Decrease liquidity from a position.

get.summary: Get "why didn't this position rebalance?" diagnostics.
Best-effort experiment config derived from `registry_open.details` and open-session lifecycle rows.

post.summary: Explicit, opt-in repair for strategy link after a close->open rotation.

get.summary: Get lifecycle summary for a position: group lifecycle ledger rows by session id and compute aggregates.

post.summary: Rebalance a position.
Link this position to a strategy (or change strategy), or unlink from all strategies.

404.description: Strategy not found when strategy_id set

get.summary: Get ordered stream lineage + per-node metrics for a position PDA.
Get "stream" performance aggregates for a position PDA (across rotated PDAs).
Get stream-level Net PnL / IL for a position PDA (across rotated PDAs).
List scripts from manifest and last run per id from `data/script_runs.jsonl`.

post.summary: Proxy a run request to `SCRIPT_RUNNER_URL` (localhost runner).
Create a new strategy.
Apply a parsed `OptimizeResultFile` (or agent envelope) to a running strategy executor without running `backtest-optimize`.
post.description:
Request JSON: either a full [`OptimizeResultFile`](clmm_lp_domain::optimize_result::OptimizeResultFile), or
`{ "decision": { ... }, "baseline_optimize_result": ... }` with [`AgentDecision`](clmm_lp_domain::agent_decision::AgentDecision).

409.description: Strategy not running, optimize_apply_policy blocks HTTP apply, or busy

post.summary: Enable or disable strategy automation for a single linked position.
Prune stale `position_addresses` (404 on-chain) for one strategy.
Start a strategy.
Stop a strategy.
Build unsigned tx for closing position.
Build unsigned tx for collecting fees.
Build unsigned tx for decreasing liquidity.
Build unsigned tx for increasing liquidity.
Build unsigned tx for opening position.
Submit signed tx (with policy gate + preflight).

get.summary: List wallet keypair files from the API host (directory).
Returns the API signing wallet pubkey and SOL balance (wallet loaded from env).
Read-only on-chain balances for a wallet owner (native SOL + SPL token accounts).

AgentChatMessage.description: One chat message in a position agent thread.

AgentChatResponse.description: Position chat timeline with session metadata.

AgentDecisionWriteRequest.description: Request body for appending one agent decision row to local JSONL.

decision.description: Free-form payload with the decision details.

ts_utc.description: Event timestamp (RFC3339 UTC recommended). If missing, API sets current UTC.

AgentDecisionsQuery.description: Query params for persisted agent decisions.

AgentLlmContext.description: Optional context for LLM answer generation.

AgentLlmReplyRequest.description: Explicit request to generate one agent answer (LLM plugin path with fallback).

AgentMessageRequest.description: User message to the position agent chat.

AgentPositionSession.description: Agent supervision session tied to one position.

AgentPositionSupervisorResponse.description: Cost/profit supervision snapshot for one position stream.

current_value_usd.description: Current live value from `GET /positions/{address}` valuation path when available.

earnings_total_usd.description: Realized + collected LP earnings proxy across chain.

elapsed_hours.description: Elapsed wall time from chain baseline timestamp to now (best-effort).

entry_capital_usd.description: Earliest known baseline value for the chain (`stream_pnl.baseline_value_usd`).

entry_token_a_ui.description: Baseline token leg quantities, if available from lineage head node.

net_since_entry_pct.description: Since-entry net result in percent of entry capital.

net_since_entry_usd.description: Since-entry net result: `current + earnings - entry - costs`.

rebalance_count.description: Number of rebalance/open-close sessions known for this chain.

scenarios.description: Scenario playbook derived from current stream condition.

AgentScanRequest.description: Trigger immediate analysis for this position.

AgentSupervisorScenario.description: Point-in-time scenario used by position supervisor.

expectation.description: One-line expectation for this market regime.

suggested_action.description: Suggested operator action for this scenario.

AgentWorkerSettings.description: Global settings for the position-agent background worker.

cross_pair_scan_interval_hours.description: Cross-pair scan cadence hint for recommendations.

default_position_scan_interval_hours.description: Default per-position scan interval used when starting session without explicit value.

include_cross_pair_scan.description: Whether background scans include cross-pair recommendations by default.

ApiSignerWalletResponse.description: `GET /wallets/api-signer` — API signing wallet (from KEYPAIR_PATH / SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH) and its SOL balance.

configured.description: Whether a signing wallet is configured on the API host.

lamports.description: Current SOL balance in lamports (when configured + RPC succeeded).

min_open_lamports.description: Minimum lamports for **open** / rent-heavy ops (`CLMM_MIN_OPEN_SOL_LAMPORTS`, default 0.012 SOL).

min_swap_lamports.description: Minimum lamports for **swap-only** (fee + buffer; lower than open; `CLMM_MIN_SWAP_SOL_LAMPORTS`, default ~0.0015 SOL).

rpc_url.description: RPC URL used for the balance read (best-effort).

sol.description: Current SOL balance as decimal string (when configured + RPC succeeded).

BacktestAutoTuneApplyResponse.description: Response for applying latest auto-tune winner to a strategy config.

BacktestAutoTuneStartRequest.description: Request for starting periodic auto-tune loop based on FULL backtests.

full_request.description: Template request used for each `POST /backtests/full` cycle.

interval_minutes.description: Interval between full optimize cycles (minutes), e.g. 15 or 30.

BacktestAutoTuneWinner.description: Latest winner snapshot extracted from FULL optimize results.

db_stale_rows.description: Number of selected pool+variant rows present in DB but older than `db_max_age_secs`.

source.description: Data source used for this response (`db` or `fallback`).

BacktestDataReadinessRequest.description: Request for data readiness diagnostics used by Backtests/Data Quality UI.

pool_ids.description: Optional curated pool ids subset (default: all curated pools with snapshots).

range_end_utc.description: Optional analysis window upper bound (inclusive, RFC3339 UTC).

range_start_utc.description: Optional analysis window lower bound (inclusive, RFC3339 UTC).

snapshot_variants.description: Snapshot variants to inspect (`10m`, `5m`). Defaults to `["10m"]`.

BacktestDataReadinessRow.description: Readiness metrics for one pool + snapshot variant.

latest_age_secs.description: Age of latest snapshot row relative to now (seconds).

status.description: Operational status for near-real-time data quality.

status_reason.description: Optional machine-readable reason explaining current status.

BacktestDataReadinessThresholds.description: Active thresholds used by readiness evaluator (resolved from ENV/defaults).

capital.description: Override: initial capital USD. By default derived from open-session token deltas.

end_date.description:
Optional end date (UTC) `YYYY-MM-DD` — forwarded to CLI as the exclusive upper bound (`ts < end`).
If omitted, the API uses the registry close **calendar day** and passes **the next day** to the CLI so intraday snapshots on the close day are not dropped (same calendar day as `--start-date` would otherwise yield an empty window).

lower.description: Override: lower bound price (A/B). By default derived from `tick_lower` in registry details.

price_path_source.description: Price path source accepted by CLI (default `snapshots`).

start_date.description: Optional start date (UTC) YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, inferred from registry_open timestamp.

strategy.description: Strategy string accepted by CLI (`static|periodic|threshold` etc.). Defaults to `static`.

upper.description: Override: upper bound price (A/B). By default derived from `tick_upper` in registry details.

capital.description: Override: initial capital USD. By default derived from open-session token deltas.

end_date.description:
Optional end date (UTC) `YYYY-MM-DD` (exclusive upper bound for CLI `ts < end`).
If omitted, API uses the next UTC calendar day from "now" so the current day is included.

lower.description: Override: lower bound price (A/B). By default derived from `tick_lower` in registry open details.

price_path_source.description: Price path source accepted by CLI (default `snapshots`).

start_date.description: Optional start date (UTC) YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, inferred from registry_open timestamp.

strategy.description: Strategy string accepted by CLI (`static|periodic|threshold` etc.). Defaults to `static`.

upper.description: Override: upper bound price (A/B). By default derived from `tick_upper` in registry open details.

BacktestFullMetricRow.description: One row from optimize ranking table (parsed from CLI output).

lower_usd.description: Lower bound of the tested LP range (USD).

upper_usd.description: Upper bound of the tested LP range (USD).

width_pct.description: Width of the tested range in percent (`(upper-lower)/mid * 100`).

BacktestFullRequest.description: Request for `POST /backtests/full` (matrix run across pools/windows with full optimize ranking).

bollinger_rebalance_hours_grid.description:
Override bollinger rebalance cadence in hours (preferred), e.g. `[2,4,8]`.
API converts hours to step counts depending on selected snapshot cadence (`10m`/`5m`).

capital_usd.description: Capital in USD used in each simulation run (`--capital` for `backtest-optimize`).

include_indicator_strategies.description: Include indicator families (Bollinger + LastCandle variants) in optimize grid.

include_strategy_ids.description: Optional strategy-family filters for grid generation (`--include-strategy-families`).

last_candle_rebalance_seconds_grid.description: Override last-candle rebalance seconds (snapshot mode), e.g. `[900,1800,3600,14400]`.

last_candle_rebalance_steps_grid.description: Override last-candle rebalance steps (non-snapshot mode), e.g. `[4,16,48]`.

last_candle_seconds_grid.description: Override last-candle candle seconds (snapshot mode), e.g. `[900,1800,3600]`.

last_candle_steps_grid.description: Override last-candle candle steps (non-snapshot mode), e.g. `[1,2,3,4]`.

lp_share.description: Optional LP share override (recommended for Meteora snapshot-only mode).

oor_recenter_deviation_pct.description:
Optional fixed OOR-recenter deviation from entry in percent (`±X%` around entry).
When set, optimize range grid is pinned to one width:
`width_pct = 2 * oor_recenter_deviation_pct` (so `10` => range `entry * (1±10%)`).

periodic_grid_steps.description: Override periodic strategy grid in hours (legacy field name kept), e.g. `[12,24,48,72]`.

pool_ids.description: Optional curated pool ids subset (default: all curated pools with snapshots).

retouch_offset_pct.description: RetouchShift only: shift full retouched band by this percent (UI value, e.g. `0.1` => +0.1%).

snapshot_variants.description:
Optional snapshot variants to compare in one run: `10m`, `5m`.
If omitted, API defaults to `["10m"]`.

static_deviation_pct.description:
Optional fixed static deviation from entry in percent (`±X%` around entry).
When set, optimize range grid is pinned to one width:
`width_pct = 2 * static_deviation_pct` (so `10` => range `entry * (1±10%)`).

static_manual_lower.description: Static only (single selected pool): manual lower range bound in price units.

static_manual_upper.description: Static only (single selected pool): manual upper range bound in price units.

target_vs_hodl_usd.description: Optional target threshold: keep only rows with `vs_hodl >= target_vs_hodl_usd`.

threshold_grid_pct.description: Override threshold grid in percent, e.g. `[2,3,5,7,10,15]`.

threshold_min_rebalance_interval_hours.description: Threshold mode: minimum interval (hours) before OOR-triggered rebalance when immediate OOR is disabled.

threshold_rebalance_on_range_exit_immedi.description: Threshold mode: if true, OOR triggers immediate rebalance (bot parity default).

snapshot_variant.description: Snapshot variant used for this result (`10m` or `5m`).

BotActivityJsonlResponse.description: Last *matching* JSON lines from `orca_position_lifecycle.jsonl` (CLI + bot tx costs).

file_missing.description: True when the file does not exist yet.

rows.description: Parsed JSON objects (newest matching lines last).

total_matching_lines.description: Lines successfully parsed (after optional substring filter).

BuildUnsignedTxRequest.description: Build unsigned tx request for position operations.

full_range.description: When `Some(true)`, build Orca full-range open (Splash-style); tick fields are ignored.

pool_address.description: Pool address if operation requires one.

position_address.description: Position address if operation requires one.

tick_lower.description: Optional Whirlpool tick lower bound (required for `open` build).

tick_upper.description: Optional Whirlpool tick upper bound (required for `open` build unless `full_range` is true).

wallet_pubkey.description: Wallet public key that will sign and pay fees.

ledger_kind.description: Wallet GL journal `kind` for paired `POST /tx/submit-signed` audit (Phase B).

position_address.description: Position PDA derived from position mint (if applicable).

position_mint.description: Position mint created for open-position flow (if applicable).

CloseAllBatchItem.description: One position row in close-all batch status.

CloseAllItemStatus.description: Per-item status in close-all batch polling.

skip_pre_collect.description: When true (default for bulk): one Orca close tx instead of separate collect + close.

slippage_bps.description: Min-out slippage for Orca close (basis points). Default **200** when omitted.

closable.description: Positions that will receive on-chain close (have API wallet for owner).

CloseAllSkippedPreview.description: Skipped position preview before batch starts.

CloseAllWalletGroup.description: Wallet group preview in close-all start response.

ClosedPositionEntry.description: One closed position entry from the append-only registry (`data/positions/registry.jsonl`).

close_kind.description: Close classification when known (`manual` vs `strategy` vs `rotation`).

last_rebalance_session_id.description: Correlation id when present (`rebalance_session_id` from registry rows).

owner.description: Owner pubkey (base58) as recorded on open/close.

pool_address.description: Pool address (base58) as recorded on open/close.

token_a_label.description: Short label for token A (e.g. SOL, USDC) when recognized (best-effort).

token_b_label.description: Short label for token B (e.g. SOL, USDC) when recognized (best-effort).

token_mint_a.description: Pool leg mint A (base58) when resolvable from pool on-chain (best-effort).

token_mint_b.description: Pool leg mint B (base58) when resolvable from pool on-chain (best-effort).

note.description: Notes about data quality / limitations (e.g. missing registry file).

confirmed.description: True when request completed and all required on-chain steps succeeded.

partial.description: True when WSOL->SOL used close + remainder re-wrap path.

post_native_lamports.description: Post-conversion native SOL balance (lamports) observed by API.

post_wsol_raw.description: Post-conversion WSOL ATA amount (raw lamports) observed by API.

rewrap_signature.description: Signature of remainder re-wrap tx for partial unwrap (when submitted).

signature.description: Backward-compatible primary signature (equals unwrap/wrap signature when present).

unwrap_signature.description: Signature of unwrap tx (WSOL ATA close) when submitted.

wrap_signature.description: Signature of wrap tx (SOL -> WSOL) when submitted.

dry_run.description: Whether to run in dry-run mode.

pool_address.description: Legacy pool on strategy (optional). New flows use pool on **Open Position**; omit or leave empty.

force.description: Overwrite existing wallet file if present.

wallet_id.description: Optional wallet id (filename stem). When omitted, generated from timestamp.

DecreaseLiquidityRequest.description: Request to decrease liquidity in a position.

liquidity_amount.description: Liquidity amount to remove (base units as decimal string; supports full u128 range in JSON).

FeesCollectedFromLedger.description: Cumulative fee collection credits from lifecycle JSONL (`bot_collect_fees` rows).

collect_events.description: Number of `bot_collect_fees` events in the file.

file_missing.description: True when the ledger file is missing or unreadable on the API host.

sum_token_a_ui.description: Sum of `fee_payer_token_a_delta_ui` when present on rows.

sum_token_b_ui.description: Sum of `fee_payer_token_b_delta_ui` when present on rows.

JupiterPricesResponse.description: `GET /prices/jupiter` — server-side Jupiter price map (avoids browser CORS/adblock).

LineageChainCostSummary.description: Aggregated **network costs** and **LP fees collected** across the full rotation chain.

fees_collected_token_a_raw_total.description: Same as `*_ui_total` but in smallest units.

fees_collected_token_a_ui_total.description: Best-effort collected LP fees (token A UI units) summed across chain.

fees_collected_token_b_ui_total.description: Best-effort collected LP fees (token B UI units) summed across chain.

tx_fee_lamports_total.description: Sum of `tx_fee_lamports` over all PDAs in `chain`.

LineageCollectZeroDiagnostics.description: One node (one PDA) in a rotated position stream lineage.

in_range_samples.description: Number of checkpoint samples used for in-range estimation.

in_range_time_share_pct_est.description: Best-effort share of sampled time where tick was inside node range (0..100).

methodology_note.description: Human-readable explanation of what this estimate means.

position_share_pct_est.description: Best-effort position liquidity share vs max sampled liquidity in same pool window (0..100).

swap_events_in_window_est.description: Best-effort number of swap events in this node's pool and time window.

LinkPositionStrategyRequest.description: Link or move a position to a strategy (`parameters.position_addresses`), or unlink from all.

strategy_id.description: Target strategy id. When `null` or omitted, removes this position PDA from every strategy.

ListPositionsMeta.description: Best-effort stats for `GET /positions` supplement merge (registry + running strategies).

light.description: `true` when response used the fast list path (no per-row full valuation).

merged_from_registry.description: Successfully merged from `registry_open` not already in monitor.

skipped_absent_cached.description: Skipped because a recent fetch returned on-chain 404.

skipped_chain_error.description: Supplement RPC attempts that failed (non-cacheable errors included).

skipped_registry_closed.description: Skipped because `registry.jsonl` marks the PDA closed.

skipped_supplement_cache.description: Supplement rows served from shared batch cache (no RPC).

MarketDataQuery.description: Common query params for normalized market-data feeds.

position_id.description: Join-friendly optional keys used by other feeds.
Join-friendly optional keys used by other feeds.

OpenPositionRequest.description: Request to open a new position.

amount_a.description: Amount of token A to deposit.

amount_b.description: Amount of token B to deposit.

chain_session_id.description: Stable chain cycle id (`CHAIN:{id}` inventory). When set, distinct from `cost_session_id` on reopen.

cost_session_id.description:
Optional id for **bookkeeping**: same value groups swap + open rows in `orca_position_lifecycle.jsonl`
(`rebalance_session_id`) so costs can be summed **per opened position** after the fact.

full_range.description: Open a **full-range** (Splash-style) position; on-chain tick bounds come from pool spacing.

strategy_id.description:
If set, after a successful open the new position PDA is appended to this strategy's
`parameters.position_addresses`.

oneOf.description:
When set, API executes an Orca **swap in this pool** first (server wallet), then opens the position.
Useful to rebalance token mix; same primitive will be reused for automated rebalance flows.

tick_lower.description: Lower tick of the range (ignored when `full_range` is true).

tick_upper.description: Upper tick of the range (ignored when `full_range` is true).

OptimizeApplyPolicy.description: Who may apply `OptimizeResultFile` updates from grid search (periodic subprocess vs HTTP vs both).

OrcaLockInfoResponse.description: Orca lock info (proxy of Orca Public REST `/lock/{address}`).

in_range.description: Pool spot tick inside `[tick_lower, tick_upper)` (same rule as monitor `in_range`).

range_lower_price.description: Generic lower bound in UI price units (token B per 1 token A).

range_lower_usdc.description: Same semantics as [`PositionResponse::range_lower_usdc`] when the pool has a USDC leg.

range_price_quote.description: e.g. `whETH per 1 SOL` — only set when `range_*_price` are present.

OrcaOwnerPositionsResponse.description: On-chain Orca Whirlpool positions for a wallet (RPC scan; same source as `orca-positions-list` CLI).

rpc_url.description: RPC URL used for the scan.

total.description: Number of position rows (bundles expand to one row per bundled position).

OrcaTokenResponse.description: Orca token response (proxy of Orca Public REST `/tokens*`).

file_missing.description: True when the file does not exist yet.

PhantomChallengeResponse.description: Challenge response to be signed by Phantom (`signMessage`).

PhantomVerifyRequest.description: Verify Phantom signature and create a short-lived session token.

PositionDiagnosticsResponse.description: Diagnostics for "why didn't this position rebalance?" (best-effort, read-only).

in_monitor.description: Whether the position exists in the in-memory monitor.

linked_strategies.description: Strategy ids that include this PDA in `parameters.position_addresses`.

monitor_in_range.description: Latest `in_range` from monitor (may lag if monitor is stale).

PositionExperimentConfigResponse.description: Best-effort canonical “experiment config” for a position (from `registry_open.details` + ledger).

PositionLifecycleEvent.description: One lifecycle/ledger row (normalized) for UI summaries.

rebalance_related_events.description: Count of events where `event` contains `rebalance` or `close+open` cycle signals (best-effort).

collected_fee_token_a_raw.description: Same as `collected_fee_token_a_ui`, but in smallest units (SPL base units; for SOL mint this is lamports).

collected_fee_token_a_ui.description:
Best-effort sum of **collected LP fees** (token A UI units) from `bot_collect_fees` rows.

Derived from `fee_payer_token_deltas` (positive deltas) for the pool's token A mint.

collected_fee_token_b_raw.description: Same as `collected_fee_token_b_ui`, but in smallest units.

collected_fee_token_b_ui.description:
Best-effort sum of **collected LP fees** (token B UI units) from `bot_collect_fees` rows.

Derived from `fee_payer_token_deltas` (positive deltas) for the pool's token B mint.

collected_fees_usd.description: Best-effort USD value of collected LP fees (A/B legs) at **current** mint prices.

positions.description: All PDAs connected to this stream when IL edges are available; otherwise only the entry PDA.

sessions.description: Sessions connected to the stream (from IL edges + lifecycle rows).

PositionListExtrasEntry.description: Per-position extras for the Positions table (replaces N× diagnostics + N× agent UI).

PositionOpenResponse.description: Response for `POST /positions` (open position), including optional swap / session metadata.

range_lower_price.description: Generic lower bound in UI price units (token B per 1 token A).

range_lower_usdc.description: When the pool is USDC vs one other token: lower bound of the range in **USDC per 1 unit of that token** (same convention as DEX UI).

range_price_quote.description: e.g. `whETH per 1 SOL` — only set when `range_*_price` are present.

range_usdc_quote.description: e.g. `per 1 SOL` — only set when `range_*_usdc` are present.

token_a_label.description: Pool token A label (e.g. SOL) when valuation succeeded.

token_b_label.description: Pool token B label (e.g. USDC) when valuation succeeded.

token_price_a_usd.description: Best-effort USD price for one UI unit of token A (free feeds).

token_price_b_usd.description: Best-effort USD price for one UI unit of token B.

oneOf.description: Per-token uncollected fees (on-chain), when pool + mint decimals could be resolved.

valuation_source.description:
Source quality for `value_usd`:
- `live_valuation`: fresh on-chain valuation path succeeded
- `fallback_monitor`: fallback to monitor cache (valuation failed)

automation_disabled_for_position.description: True when this position is in `executor_disabled_position_addresses`.

oneOf.description: Last evaluation snapshot from the running executor (if available).

PositionStreamLineageNode.description: One node (one PDA) in a rotated position stream lineage.

baseline_valuation_quality.description: Data quality/source tag for baseline valuation (e.g. `exact`, `missing_price`, `fallback`).

baseline_value_usd.description: Baseline value for this PDA (earliest known valuation snapshot).

chain_history_event_spot_token_a_usd_clo.description: Close-event USD spot for token A (stored in SQL column `event_price_b_usd` at materialize), as string.

chain_history_event_spot_token_a_usd_ope.description: Open-event USD spot for token A (`event_price_a_usd` on earliest open ledger row), as string.

chain_history_start_value_usd.description: `GET …/chain-history` only: `start_value_usd` when **> 0** (zero in DB = unknown at materialize; omitted so UI falls back).

chain_history_tick_lower_open.description: `GET …/chain-history` only: open tick lower from persisted ledger row (`tick_*` / `new_tick_*`).

closed_ts_utc.description: Latest valuation snapshot timestamp for this PDA (best-effort close/current time).

collect_events.description: Count of `bot_collect_fees` ledger rows for this PDA.

oneOf.description: Extra diagnostics for collect rows that show zero LP fees.

current_valuation_quality.description: Data quality/source tag for current/end valuation.

current_value_usd.description: Latest known value for this PDA (latest valuation snapshot).

fees_collected_token_a_raw.description: Same as `fees_collected_token_*_ui`, but in smallest units (SPL base units; for SOL mint this is lamports).

fees_collected_token_a_ui.description: Best-effort collected LP fees for pool token A (UI units) from `bot_collect_fees` rows.

fees_collected_token_b_ui.description: Best-effort collected LP fees for pool token B (UI units).

fees_collected_usd.description: LP **fees collected** in USD: positive token deltas from `bot_collect_fees` rows for pool mints × current USD prices.

lifecycle_close_nav_usd.description: NAV at close from lifecycle `close_amount_*_raw` × event spot (exact at tx); used when `current_value_usd` is 0.

net_pnl_usd.description: Net PnL estimate for this PDA: current_value + realized_cashflow - baseline_value - tx_fees.

note.description: Notes about data quality / limitations for this node.

opened_ts_utc.description: Earliest valuation snapshot timestamp for this PDA (best-effort open time).

realized_cashflow_usd.description: Realized cashflow estimate in USD from `fee_payer_token_deltas` (pool legs) for this PDA.

token_a_label.description: Optional token labels/mints for the pool legs (best-effort; enables pair display for closed PDAs).

tx_fee_lamports.description: Sum of Solana **network** tx fees (`meta.fee`) in lamports for all lifecycle rows for this PDA.

tx_fees_usd.description: Network tx fees in USD (`tx_fee_lamports` × SOL/USD).

PositionStreamLineageResponse.description: Ordered lineage for a position stream (root → … → current) plus per-node metrics.

oneOf.description: Whole-chain rollup of network tx costs vs LP fees collected (sum of per-node fields).

chain_history_materialized_ts_utc.description:
When this payload was last written to Postgres (`position_chain_history_meta.materialized_ts_utc`).
Present only on `GET …/chain-history`; omitted on live `stream-lineage`.

nodes.description: Same chain as `chain`, but enriched with per-node aggregates.

position_address.description: Entry point PDA (base58) used for traversal.

PositionStreamPerformanceResponse.description: Stream-level aggregates for a position PDA (across close->open rotations).

collected_token_a_ui.description: Sum of `fee_payer_token_a_delta_ui` across collect events (token A UI units).

collected_token_b_ui.description: Sum of `fee_payer_token_b_delta_ui` across collect events (token B UI units).

note.description: Optional info about limitations / data quality.

position_address.description: Position PDA used as the entry point for graph traversal.

positions.description: All known PDAs connected to this stream (from IL ledger edges).

sessions.description: All known `rebalance_session_id`s connected to this stream.

total_tx_fee_lamports.description: Total network fee across matching lifecycle rows (lamports).

total_tx_fee_usd.description: Total network fee in USD (best-effort, SOL/USD from free price fetch).

PositionStreamPnLResponse.description: Stream-level Net PnL / IL across rotated position PDAs (best-effort).

baseline_ts_utc.description: Baseline snapshot timestamp (earliest known for the stream).

baseline_value_usd.description: Baseline value in USD (from earliest valuation snapshot).

clean_il_pct.description: Clean IL% vs HODL, excluding LP fees.

clean_il_usd.description: Clean IL in USD (LP principal mark - HODL), excluding LP fees.

current_ts_utc.description: Current snapshot timestamp (latest known for the stream).

current_value_usd.description: Current value in USD (from latest valuation snapshot).

end_nav_source.description: How headline end NAV was resolved (`live_current`, `lifecycle_close_amounts`, `close_estimate`, …).

hodl_value_usd.description: HODL value in USD for the baseline basket at current prices (used for IL).

il_pct.description:
Clean IL% (LP principal - HODL) / HODL.

Kept for backward compatibility; same value as `clean_il_pct`.

il_usd.description:
Clean IL in USD (LP principal - HODL) for the baseline basket.

Kept for backward compatibility; same value as `clean_il_usd`.

interpretation.description: Short Polish captions so UI can show economic PnL and IL benchmark side-by-side without mixing them.

lp_fees_total_usd.description: Total LP fees included in the fee-inclusive LP-vs-HODL benchmark.

lp_vs_hodl_with_fees_pct.description: LP-vs-HODL with LP fees, divided by HODL value.

lp_vs_hodl_with_fees_usd.description: LP-vs-HODL in USD after adding realized + uncollected LP fees.

net_pnl_usd.description: Net PnL in USD: current_value + realized_cashflow - baseline_value - tx_fees.

position_address.description: Position PDA used as the entry point.

realized_cashflow_usd.description: Realized cashflow estimate in USD from lifecycle `fee_payer_token_deltas` for pool leg mints.

realized_lp_fees_usd.description: Realized LP fees in USD from collect/close fee legs, excluding principal.

tx_fees_usd.description: Total network fees in USD (tx_fee_lamports × SOL/USD).

uncollected_lp_fees_usd.description: Uncollected/claimable LP fees in USD for the active final PDA (0 for closed/end-close streams).

valuation_price_time_kind.description: Price basis used for HODL/IL valuation (`at_tx_event`, `live_price`, `free_price_fallback`, etc.).

PositionsListExtrasRequest.description: Request for batch list row extras (strategy link + agent session).

QuoteOpenBudgetRequest.description: Body: size an in-range open so **on-chain notional** is close to `target_usd` (Whirlpool caps).

chain_session_id.description: When set, quote sizes against **CHAIN:{id}** inventory (not global wallet). Same id as open `cost_session_id` / chain cycle.

cost_session_id.description: Alias for `chain_session_id` (bookkeeping session from swap/open flow).

target_usd.description: Desired position value in USD (both legs, at server price snapshot).

chain_wallet_notional_usd.description: CHAIN/SESSION wallet notional used for sizing (USD, capped inventory).

in_range.description: True when pool spot lies inside `[tick_lower, tick_upper)`.

RebalanceInput.description: How the API should choose the new tick range for `POST /positions/{address}/rebalance`.

center_price.description: When `input` is `price_band`: center price (B per A) for the new range.

input.description: How to derive `new_tick_lower` / `new_tick_upper`. Defaults to `ticks` for backward compatibility.

range_width_pct.description: When `input` is `strategy_range` or `price_band`: range width in percent (e.g. `1.0` = 1%). Overrides strategy when both are set.

strategy_id.description: When `input` is `strategy_range`: load `parameters.range_width_pct` from this strategy (optional if `range_width_pct` is set).

RunScriptRequest.description: `POST /scripts/{id}/run` — forwarded to localhost runner when configured.

ScriptCatalogItem.description: Entry from `tools/scripts-manifest.json` (and/or auto-scan `tools/*.ps1`) plus optional last run metadata.

auto_discovered.description: True when the row came from filesystem scan only (no row in `scripts-manifest.json`).

ScriptRunRecord.description: One row appended to `data/script_runs.jsonl` by the localhost runner.

ScriptsListResponse.description: `GET /scripts` — manifest + last run per script (from JSONL).

runner_configured.description: `SCRIPT_RUNNER_URL` and `SCRIPT_RUNNER_TOKEN` are set (run may still fail if runner is down).

gbm_volatility.description: Annualized GBM volatility for the **synthetic** price path (0.55 ≈ 55%).

periodic_interval_steps.description: For `Periodic`: rebalance every N simulation steps (default 7 with daily steps ≈ weekly).

strategy_type.description: Strategy type (default: static range — no rebalance).

threshold_pct.description: For `Threshold` / `OorRecenter`: midpoint deviation threshold (e.g. 0.05 = 5%). Ignored for OOR-only if using defaults below.

methodology_note.description: How the price path and strategy were chosen (transparency for operators).

sharpe_ratio.description: Sharpe ratio (annualized, heuristic from PnL path).

vs_hodl_usd.description: Final value minus HODL of initial capital at final/entry price ratio.

SlackActivitySummaryRequest.description: POST body: how many recent ledger rows to include in the Slack digest.

limit.description: Max rows from the **tail** of the lifecycle ledger (after parse). Capped at 80.

SlackActivitySummaryResponse.description: Result of posting a digest to Slack Incoming Webhook.

error.description: Error or provider message when `ok` is false.

rows_included.description: Rows formatted into the message body.

SlipstreamSlot0Response.description: `slot0()` on a Slipstream / Uniswap-v3–style pool contract (`GET .../slot0`).

sqrt_price_x96.description: `sqrtPriceX96` as a decimal string (fits uint160; string avoids JSON precision loss).

StaleReconcileReportResponse.description: Result of stale position reconcile / strategy prune (registry + strategy links).

lifecycle_backfilled.description: Lifecycle `bot_close_position` rows recovered from on-chain close txs.

StrandedRebalanceItem.description: One rebalance session where close was observed but corresponding open is missing.

StrandedRebalancesResponse.description: Watchdog response with detected stranded rebalance sessions and optional enqueue count.

agent_max_width_pct_delta.description: When using `POST .../apply-optimize-result` with an agent envelope, cap `|Δ winner.width_pct|` vs `baseline_optimize_result` (same units as backtest: fraction, e.g. `0.02` = 2 percentage points).

auto_start.description: If true, API will auto-start this strategy on boot unless `CLMM_STRATEGY_AUTOSTART_ON_BOOT` is set to a false-ish value (unset env ⇒ autostart allowed).

bollinger_window.description: Bollinger: rolling window size in points/samples.

executor_disabled_position_addresses.description: Position PDAs for which this strategy's executor skips automation (decisions / txs).

il_ledger_path.description: Append IL / rebalance ledger lines (JSONL) to this file.

min_rebalance_interval_minutes.description: Minimum rebalance interval in minutes (preferred live/UI field).

optimize_apply_policy.description: Whether periodic subprocess, external HTTP apply, or both may update the executor from grid results (see `OptimizeApplyPolicy`).

optimize_command.description:
argv for the CLI: `[program, subcommand, ...]` e.g. `["clmm-lp-cli","backtest-optimize",...]`.
If `--optimize-result-json` is omitted, the API appends it using `optimize_result_json_path`.

optimize_interval_secs.description: Period in seconds between background optimize runs (0 = disabled).

optimize_on_start.description: Run `clmm-lp-cli backtest-optimize` once when the strategy starts (before the executor loop).

optimize_result_json_path.description: Path passed to `--optimize-result-json` (written by CLI, read by API).

periodic_requires_out_of_range.description:
If true, `Periodic` strategy triggers only when the position is out of range.
Default (when omitted) is `true`.

position_addresses.description: Position PDAs linked via Open Position (`strategy_id`) or API; seeded when the strategy starts.

rebalance_on_range_exit_immediately.description:
If true, range-exit may trigger immediate close+open (rebalance) instead of waiting for the interval.
Default (when omitted) is `false`.

retouch_offset_pct.description: RetouchShift only: shift full retouched band by this percent (e.g. 0.1 => +0.1%).

StrategyPositionExecutorRequest.description: Toggle per-position automation for a running strategy (`executor_disabled_position_addresses`).

auto_execute.description: Whether the executor may submit transactions without manual confirmation (requires wallet when not dry-run).

pool_address.description:
Legacy: pool was previously stored on the strategy. New strategies use per-position pools;
this is `None` unless present in stored config.

StreamPnLInterpretation.description: Human-readable separation of **economic** chain PnL vs **IL benchmark** (Polish copy for dashboard).

chain_history_anchors.description:
Optional position pubkey strings (e.g. from `/tx/*/build` `position_address`) to refresh
materialized chain-history after a successful RPC send.

correlation_id.description: From `BuildUnsignedTxResponse.correlation_id` — ties submit to build (Phase B journal).

wallet_pubkey.description: Fee payer / signer wallet (from build request `wallet_pubkey`).

SwapBeforeOpenRequest.description:
Request to execute **only** an Orca Whirlpool swap (ExactIn) inside a pool.

Intended for a 2-step UI flow:
1) SWAP to cover token mix
2) later OPEN a position (optionally with the same `cost_session_id` for bookkeeping).

amount_in.description: Raw amount (smallest units) of `specified_mint` to swap.

chain_session_id.description: Stable chain cycle id for CHAIN portfolio caps (distinct from `cost_session_id` on reopen).

cost_session_id.description: Optional bookkeeping id; same value groups swap + open rows in `orca_position_lifecycle.jsonl`.

slippage_tolerance_bps.description: Swap slippage tolerance in basis points.

specified_mint.description: SPL mint for ExactIn direction (must equal pool `token_mint_a` or `token_mint_b`).

SwapCostEstimateResponse.description: Rough **network fee** estimate for an Orca swap in a pool (`meta.fee` band), from local ledger history + default.

default_network_fee_lamports.description: Fallback when there is no history (typical base + small priority band).

estimated_network_fee_lamports.description: Value to display: `max(default, median)` when median is present, else default.

historical_median_network_fee_lamports.description: Median `tx_fee_lamports` from prior `swap_exact_in` rows for this pool (if any).

historical_sample_count.description: Rows used for the median (same pool).

note.description: Explains that full wallet delta is logged after confirmation in `orca_position_lifecycle.jsonl`.

SwapInPoolBeforeOpen.description:
Optional **Orca Whirlpool swap in the same pool** before opening liquidity (ExactIn).

Use the pool's token A or B mint as `specified_mint` (same semantics as `orca swap` / `swap_instructions`).

amount_in.description: Raw amount (smallest units) of `specified_mint` to swap before the open-position tx.

specified_mint.description: SPL mint for ExactIn direction (must equal pool `token_mint_a` or `token_mint_b`).

UncollectedFeesInfo.description:
Uncollected LP fees from the Whirlpool position account (`fee_owed_a` / `fee_owed_b`), in human
token units — same semantics as the Orca app “uncollected fees” before a collect transaction.

token_a_label.description: Short label for pool token A (e.g. SOL, USDC, or truncated mint).

WalletBalancesResponse.description: `GET /wallets/balances` — on-chain read-only balances for an owner pubkey.

token_2022_error.description: Best-effort error text for Token-2022 read when failed.

token_accounts_total.description: Number of token-account rows discovered before mint-level merge.

token_legacy_error.description: Best-effort error text for legacy SPL read when failed.

WalletChainCollectedFeesSummary.description: Σ LP fees collected across one `chain_session_id` (collect + close fee legs; excludes principal).

collect_events.description: Count of `bot_collect_fees` lifecycle rows in the chain.

direction.description: Portfolio perspective: `in` = credit to chain wallet, `out` = debit to pool/swap/fee.

chain_balance_usd_legs.description: Non-zero CHAIN wallet mints with USD legs (cycle spot; excludes LP NAV).

chain_wallet_excluded_mint_count.description: Non-strategy mint rows hidden from `chain_balance_usd_legs` (phantom GL / PSLR noise).

collected_fees.description: LP fees realized in this chain cycle (collect rows + fee legs on close; not tx fees).

ledger_events.description: Chronological strategy wallet journal (one row per lifecycle posting / tx fee).

lp_nav_usd.description: Echo of `lp_nav_usd` query param (head position NAV from caller).

portfolio_balance_usd.description: CHAIN GL wallet total USD (open-time prices); excludes LP NAV.

cache_source.description: `chain`, `memory`, `file`, or `warmup`; helps operators understand whether this is a live or cached view.

cache_updated_at_utc.description: Wall-clock timestamp when this effective snapshot was written to the cache.

is_stale.description: True when response comes from stale cache or warmup placeholder.

rpc_url.description: Compatibility fields for existing Wallet/Swap UI.

stale_age_ms.description: Cache age in milliseconds for stale responses.

WalletEntry.description: One wallet keypair discovered on disk (API host).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of wallet file bytes (hex, best-effort).

id.description: Stable id for UI (usually filename stem).

present_in_primary.description: Wallet file exists in primary storage.

present_in_secondary.description: Wallet file exists in secondary storage.

opening_import_applied.description: True after a successful `POST …/opening-import` for this owner.

WalletGlRpcReconcileGap.description: Per-mint gap for `GET /wallets/reconcile-wallet-gl` (GL vs effective-balances RPC).

delta_raw.description: GL − RPC in raw on-chain units (string i128).

WalletGlRpcReconcileResponse.description: Response for `GET /wallets/reconcile-wallet-gl` — shadow compare WALLET GL vs RPC.

WalletLedgerDelta.description: One SPL leg: signed change in **smallest units** (`raw_delta_i128` as decimal string).

native_lamports_delta.description: Native SOL lamport change for `owner` (decimal string of i64).

storage.description: `postgres`, `jsonl`, or `jsonl_fallback` (Postgres connected but no rows yet).

WalletLedgerStatus.description: Status of a ledger line: in-flight, confirmed on-chain, or failed before/at submit.

WalletSessionBalanceRow.description: One mint balance on a logical `SESSION:{session_id}` account (analytics shadow GL).

gl_matches_pslr.description: GL aggregate matches PSLR replay for this session.

oneOf.description: Cycle-start reference from first open row in lifecycle (when Postgres + PSLR rows exist).

needs_reconcile.description: True when GL is empty/mismatch/untrusted — run backfill or reconcile.

current_balance_usd_legs.description: Per-mint USD legs for current session wallet (sum ≈ `current_value_usd`).

delta_vs_pre_open_usd.description: Current session USD minus pre-open USD (open event prices).

metrics_trusted.description: False when lifecycle rows lack resolvable pool mints (legacy close rows); USD session metrics may be wrong.

WalletSessionOpenStartSnapshot.description: First **open** in session: deployed capital + pre-open session inventory (USD at event prices).

deployed_balances.description: Positive raw amounts deployed into the LP at cycle start.

mint_resolution.description: `details` | `pool_address` | `incomplete` — pool leg mint resolution for open row.

price_by_mint_usd.description: USD prices from open lifecycle row (`event_price_*`), used to mark current session wallet.

ui_amount.description: UI amount as string (from jsonParsed RPC).

WalletTransferLogEntry.description: One transfer log entry (append-only JSONL on API host).

from_wallet_id.description: Wallet id from local wallets storage (`/wallets`).

events_total.description: WS events received from account/program/log subscriptions.

owners_monitored.description: Owners with active WS monitor workers.

reconnects_total.description: Number of reconnect loops started after WS worker errors.

refresh_failures_total.description: Number of failed WS-triggered cache refreshes.

WalletsListResponse.description: `GET /wallets` — list wallets from a directory on the API host.

transfer_max_lamports.description: Optional maximum lamports per SOL transfer.

transfer_min_lamports.description: Minimum lamports per SOL transfer (dust guard).

wallets_dir_primary.description: Primary wallets directory scanned on API host.

wallets_dir_secondary.description: Secondary wallets directory scanned on API host (optional).
